scope: Two-input add/divide, stable read-only calculation points, existing single Go application
environment: Isolated loopback-only software Modbus TCP fixture; synthetic values explicitly named non-measured in the UI. No hardware or production connections.

browser.initial_workflow: Created A and B through actual channel/point forms, capacity through the virtual-input form, and total/ratio through calculation forms; explicitly applied each definition.
browser.input_failure: Synthetic A read failure removed both current values; historical 70/0.7 remained explicitly labelled with original times. Recovery restored 70/0.7.
browser.trial: Fixed 20/30/100 returned intermediate 50 and ratio 0.5 while live remained 70/0.7; denominator 0 showed an unavailable result and division-by-zero diagnosis. Final build also returned fixed 70/0.7 while live stayed 50/0.5, with simulation labels on intermediate direct-input evidence.
browser.draft_application: Saved an incorrect kWh output draft; live values and applied v1 remained 70/0.7. Application preview rejected output-unit mismatch. Restored draft to kW; impact preview named the dependent ratio.
browser.query_failure: Injected GET /calculations 503 cleared all current-value elements, displayed failure and a retry action; recovery restored the list.
browser.keyboard: Output-unit input retained focus and typed kWh across polling before save.

authorization.revocation_red: Same token/parent scope, implementer actions changed to export-only: API returned edit=false/apply=false while old UI editor and enabled save remained visible.
authorization.revocation_green: After fix, next successful authorization refresh removed the editor and save button. Failed refresh also clears sensitive overlays; late trial/impact responses recheck current authorization.
authorization.apply_only_red: Viewer with calculation_apply could apply through API but had no calculation UI.
authorization.apply_only_green: Reused the customer workbench's runtime-input drawer. Viewer applied the ratio through the actual confirmation UI; API and UI showed 0.5, formula v1, edit=false/apply=true. No create/edit/trial buttons were offered.

browser.final_console: No console errors on the final fixture. Earlier 400 invalid-application and injected 503 responses were deliberate negative cases; startup navigation retry errors were not application API failures.
browser.screenshot_limit: Preview screenshots were produced but the host returned tiny thumbnails; responsive verification uses DOM bounding boxes and computed styles rather than screenshot readability.

persisted_definition_and_runtime_sample.note: Public API definitions are loaded from persisted SIOT documents, not the editor's local state. Observation labels describe the acquisition pathway; all observations in this fixture are synthetic, not hardware measurements.

automated_checks.frontend_result: passed; existing >500 kB Vite chunk warning remains
automated_checks.failed_full_run: Initial parallel final run exposed pre-existing cross-package port 9743 reuse (appapi capability-rich fixture and decision RTU fixture), plus transient 503 at startup login. No failure was treated as a pass; the final full suite was rerun serially after bounded startup-readiness handling in the new restart test.
coverage: draft/applied separation and independent action ACL
real source acquisition stamps and edit/revert
coherent batches and original leaf-time skew
no stored observation replay after restart
fixed complete trial inputs and no live mutation

final_review.method: One fresh-context parallel Standards and Spec review; one implementation fix pass, no re-review

fixed.red: HTTP edit completed while older expected configuration capture was blocked
fixed.green: Relevant configuration routes share capture serialization; changed point/bus invalidates dependent cache before subsequent reads

fixed.red: Three-level retained result exposed contribution from a now-hidden intermediate
fixed.green: Immutable complete dependency closure retained with results and checked under current authorization

fixed.test: Actual browser with same-session action revocation
fixed.red: Old editor and enabled save remained
fixed.green: Authorization refresh closes unavailable actions; query failures clear overlays and late responses recheck access

fixed.test: Actual viewer account with calculation_apply only
fixed.red: API permitted application but no reachable UI
fixed.green: Existing customer runtime drawer exposes authorized calculation operations without widening navigation or edit rights

final_review.declined_scope: Hardware/control simulation isolation and full project configuration transactions remain out of this ticket; no real-device sign-off is claimed.

rulings.decision: Sequential work in the existing checkout and dedicated local branch
rulings.why: Approved inline execution with shared interfaces
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Shared filesystem requires avoiding concurrent writers

rulings.decision: Graph validation separate from draft shape
rulings.why: Invalid graphs must remain diagnosable drafts
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Every application path must enforce graph validation

rulings.decision: In-process runtime with immutable public snapshot; app adapter owns I/O
rulings.why: No separate service and no GET-driven evaluation
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Lifecycle and capture serialization must remain explicit

rulings.why: Editing back must not revive stale observations
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Equivalent saved configuration can briefly wait for fresh input

rulings.decision: Unbound copied drafts are readable/editable but not applicable
rulings.why: Unmapped external references must not silently activate or disappear
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Trial and application must retain strict binding validation

rulings.why: Inputs and formulas share the same change-confirmation boundary
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Coverage does not prove all external consumers

rulings.decision: Reuse customer runtime-input drawer for apply-only actors
rulings.why: Independent action grants require an accessible operation, without adding navigation
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Drawer can become long with many points

rulings.decision: Serial full Go suite and bounded startup-login 503 wait
rulings.why: Existing fixtures reuse ports; real startup authentication is asynchronous
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Tests run longer; temporary startup unavailability is tolerated only within five seconds, not wrong credentials or persistent failures

limitations: No full historical result platform or backfill
No new protocol or real control binding
Simulator is not hardware; M5 sign-off pending
No claim that every T33 scenario is implemented
No GitHub issue/PR publication or push
